description: Migrates an old style to the current MapLibre Style Specification, the same way as gl-style-migrate: version 7 styles become version 8, and legacy functions and filters become expressions. A style given as a file path is migrated in place, otherwise the migrated JSON is returned.

path.description: Path to a style JSON file, relative to the directory the server runs in.

style.description: The style as a JSON object.

url.description: URL of a style JSON document.

name: migrate_style
title: Migrate style
